Every dataset Lotline uses: where it came from, which version, when it was accessed, under what license,
how it was cleaned, and its known limitations (Participant Handbook, Data and Resources). Data is downloaded
by `lotline fetch` into `LOTLINE_DATA_DIR`, never committed; each download is logged with its sha256 in
`manifest.jsonl` there, so a pull can be verified byte for byte.

## Datasets

### Census 2020 redistricting data (P.L. 94-171): names and total population

- **Source id:** `census_dec_pl` → table `jurisdictions` (adapter `national.decennial` v1.0)
- **Source:** https://www.census.gov/programs-surveys/decennial-census/about/rdo/summary-files.html
- **Version:** 2020
- **Accessed:** 2026-10-06
- **Files:** 12 (0.7 MB); URLs and sha256 in `manifest.jsonl`
- **License / terms:** Public domain (U.S. Government work, 17 U.S.C. §105)

**Cleaning steps**

1. Short names (before the first comma) and P1_001N total population for counties, places and county subdivisions
1. Joined to the BPS jurisdiction universe by GEOID

**Known limitations**

- Jurisdictions dissolved or renamed before 2020 keep their BPS name and no population
- Unincorporated county areas get no population (county totals would overstate them)
- 2020 counts carry Census disclosure-avoidance noise for small places

### Census American Community Survey 5-year estimates (B25024, B25003, B25064, B25077, B25034)

- **Source id:** `census_acs5` → table `acs_geo_year` (adapter `national.acs` v1.0)
- **Source:** https://www.census.gov/data/developers/data-sets/acs-5year.html
- **Version:** 2010–2024 (15 vintages)
- **Accessed:** 2026-10-06
- **Files:** 615 (123.8 MB); URLs and sha256 in `manifest.jsonl`
- **License / terms:** Public domain (U.S. Government work, 17 U.S.C. §105)

**Cleaning steps**

1. Long format: one row per geography, 5-year vintage and variable, with the published 90% MOE
1. Census special-value codes become missing; a 'controlled' MOE (-555555555) becomes 0
1. Labels kept per vintage because some categories change over time

**Known limitations**

- Adjacent 5-year vintages share four years of sample: never difference them
- 0.3-2% of estimates are suppressed, mostly small places and townships
- Requires a free Census API key (CENSUS_API_KEY); the key is never written to the manifest

### Census Building Permits Survey (BPS), annual place-level files

- **Source id:** `census_bps_place_annual` → table `bps_place_year` (adapter `national.bps` v1.0)
- **Source:** https://www.census.gov/construction/bps/
- **Version:** 1992–2025 (34 vintages); publisher files last modified up to 2026-05-14
- **Accessed:** 2026-10-06
- **Files:** 68 (57.7 MB); URLs and sha256 in `manifest.jsonl`
- **License / terms:** Public domain (U.S. Government work, 17 U.S.C. §105)

**Cleaning steps**

1. Parse each regional annual file; ID columns found by header name (layouts change by era)
1. Keep units and buildings for 1, 2, 3-4 and 5+ unit buildings, both imputed totals and reported-only
1. Flag `imputed` when a place reported fewer than 12 months or reported units differ from the total
1. Assign GEOIDs: place, else county subdivision, else county for unincorporated/'County Part' rows; backfill earlier years by BPS ID (1992 on), then county + name, then unique name
1. Remove held-out place-years (validation/holdout.py) before the table is written

**Known limitations**

- BPS 6-digit IDs were renumbered in 1992 and reused; pre-1992 rows link by name only
- Before 2009, 0.07-2.9% of units belong to places that left the survey before FIPS codes existed and cannot be placed
- ADUs are often not recorded as new units (Upzoned #301); BPS may undercount them
- NC's BPS universe has ~157 places; most small towns' permits sit in county unincorporated totals
- Place sums exceed Census state totals in some years because Census revises state and county totals after the annual survey (BPS methodology); MN, NC, OH within 1% except 1992-93; TX 1-2% high in 2003-2014, concentrated in county unincorporated rows (e.g. Denton County 2014: +2,145 units). See reports/<st>/V0-national.md

### Census Building Permits Survey (BPS), annual state totals (reconciliation only)

- **Source id:** `census_bps_state_annual` → table `none (V0 check against bps_place_year)` (adapter `national.bps_state` v1.0)
- **Source:** https://www.census.gov/construction/bps/
- **Version:** 1992–2025 (34 vintages); publisher files last modified up to 2026-05-14
- **Accessed:** 2026-10-06
- **Files:** 34 (0.4 MB); URLs and sha256 in `manifest.jsonl`
- **License / terms:** Public domain (U.S. Government work, 17 U.S.C. §105)

**Cleaning steps**

1. Parse units for 1, 2, 3-4 and 5+ unit buildings (with imputation) per state and year

**Known limitations**

- Used only to check that place files add up; never an input to the model
- Held-out state-years are not compared, so a held-out place can't be recovered by subtraction

### FHFA House Price Index, annual all-transactions (state, CBSA, county, ZIP5, tract)

- **Source id:** `fhfa_hpi_annual` → table `market_geo_year` (adapter `national.fhfa` v1.0)
- **Source:** https://www.fhfa.gov/data/hpi/datasets
- **Version:** current
- **Accessed:** 2026-10-06
- **Files:** 5 (137.3 MB); URLs and sha256 in `manifest.jsonl`
- **License / terms:** Public domain (U.S. Government work, 17 U.S.C. §105)

**Cleaning steps**

1. Skip FHFA's title rows; keep native HPI, HPI with 2000 base, and annual change
1. Prefix geography codes by level (county:27053, zip5:55415, ...)
1. Assign ZIP5 to states by USPS 3-digit prefix ranges (config/states); keep CBSAs touching the state
1. Suppressed years are left missing, never interpolated

**Known limitations**

- Sub-state annual indexes are labeled 'developmental' by FHFA
- Thin places suppressed: TX county indexes for 179 of 254 counties; 1-9% of tract-years missing
- FHFA overwrites files in place; earlier vintages survive only as manifest hashes
- Native HPI is base 100 in each series' first year; compare places with the base-2000 index

### FRED: 30-year mortgage rate (Freddie Mac PMMS), PPI residential construction inputs, CPI-U

- **Source id:** `fred` → table `market_geo_year` (adapter `national.fred` v1.0)
- **Source:** https://fred.stlouisfed.org/
- **Version:** 2026-10; publisher files last modified up to 2026-10-01
- **Accessed:** 2026-10-06
- **Files:** 3 (0.1 MB); URLs and sha256 in `manifest.jsonl`
- **License / terms:** Freddie Mac PMMS, republished by FRED with permission; attribution required; Public domain (BLS, U.S. Government work)
- **Required attribution:** Mortgage rates: Freddie Mac, Primary Mortgage Market Survey, via FRED (with permission)

**Cleaning steps**

1. Calendar-year means over complete years only (52+ weekly or 12 monthly observations)
1. A single missing observation between two published ones is linearly interpolated (Oct 2025 CPI)
1. Stored at geo national:US for every state

**Known limitations**

- BLS published no October 2025 CPI (federal shutdown); 2025 CPI uses an interpolated October
- FRED revises series in place; raw copies are kept per month pulled
- The mortgage rate is Freddie Mac data: attribution required wherever it is shown
